items.name: component-ui
items.title: NocoBase File Component UI
items.description: Application-owned upload, list, thumbnail, and preview components for business file endpoints.
items.docs: Install editable file components, resolve clientFileRepositoryManagerToken from the App, and pass manager.repository(resourceName) to FileUploadField. Read components use FileRecord.contentUrl. The App owns routes, authorization and business relations. Upgrade installed source with a three-way merge.
